# Docuvia Coding Guidelines

When writing or refactoring TypeScript/React code, you MUST adhere strictly to the guidelines defined in the `docs/gitbook/guidelines/` directory.

Read the specific guideline files before making architectural or logic changes:

1. `docs/gitbook/guidelines/01-typescript-react-style.md` (Naming, React component structure)
2. `docs/gitbook/guidelines/02-architecture-mvc.md` (MVC, shared `lib/` logic)
3. `docs/gitbook/guidelines/03-pop-and-srp.md` (POP, SRP, Interface-driven)
4. `docs/gitbook/guidelines/04-clean-code.md` (DRY, no repeated logic, constants, defensive code)
5. `docs/gitbook/guidelines/05-tdd-and-testing.md` (TDD, 3A pattern)
6. `docs/gitbook/guidelines/06-sre-and-reliability.md` (Metrics, Circuit Breaking, Async Processing)
